newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pac units to enhance motor business.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pac units to enhance motor business.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd said its 60-percent indirectly owned Gentech Vehicle Engineering Ltd and its unit Dah Chong Hong Ltd have entered into agreement aiming to enhance competitiveness of the group in the motor industry.

CITIC said Gentch has agreed to buy vehicle chassis and other components from vehicle chassis and motor services supplier Dah Chong Hong, and Dah Chong Hong will in return subcontract body building work to Gentech.
The anticipated monetary value of the deal will not exceed 0.2 percent of the net asset value of CITIC group for the year ending December 31, 1996, or HK$53 million, it said.
